# Awesome Free Mini Tools 1000

Last updated: 2026-04-14

## Summary (English)
Awesome Free Mini Tools 1000 is a browser-first collection of text, image, data, developer, and productivity utilities. The site focuses on privacy-first, frontend-only tools that run without mandatory sign-up or server-side processing.

## Summary (Traditional Chinese)
Awesome Free Mini Tools 1000 是以瀏覽器直接執行為核心的工具集合，涵蓋文字、圖片、資料轉換、開發與生產力任務。重點是前端本地處理、免登入、降低資料外傳風險。

## Summary (Japanese)
Awesome Free Mini Tools 1000 は、テキスト処理、画像処理、データ変換、開発支援、生産性向上のためのブラウザツール集です。多くの機能はフロントエンドだけで動作し、登録不要で使えます。

## Key Pages
- / : Collection overview and FAQ
- /?tool={tool-path} : Individual tool pages with shareable URLs
- /llms.txt : AI-readable summary
- /sitemap.xml : Full crawl map
- /news-sitemap.xml : Recently refreshed tool URLs

## Topics
- Browser-based utilities
- Text processing and data conversion
- Image helpers and chart generators
- Developer tools and productivity workflows

## Freshness
- Tool URLs are generated into the sitemap during build.
- The collection is designed for continuous additions.
